scope: 官方一手来源和数据集说明中的可复用真实对象三维几何；本文件不声称已接入、量测或验证任何网格。

performed: 读取官方网页、馆藏元数据、论文、公开API响应和数据集脚本
对少量单件直链执行HTTP HEAD以确认公开访问状态、类型和字节数
not_performed: 没有下载扫描网格、模型档案或图像媒体
没有申请账户、付费或联系数据提供方
没有检查OBJ/GLB/PLY顶点、UV、内腔、底面、坐标单位或watertight状态

evidence_labels.FACT_FROM_SOURCE: 来源直接报告的事实、尺寸、格式、扫描流程或许可证
evidence_labels.VISUAL_INFERENCE: 页面图像/可视化呈现出的定性判断，不是尺寸测量
evidence_labels.DESIGN_ASSUMPTION: 未来生成器可能补入的设计值，必须明确标记为假设
evidence_labels.UNKNOWN: 本次官方来源没有报告或无法从元数据确认的属性

capture.source: Physical YCB objects captured on the BigBIRD scanning rig.
capture.reported_setup: 5 RGB-D sensors and 5 high-resolution RGB cameras on a quarter-circular arc; object on computer-controlled turntable, 3-degree step, 120 positions; 600 RGB-D and 600 RGB images per object.
capture.mesh_processing: Poisson surface reconstruction; official paper describes resulting meshes as watertight.
capture.bottom: Paper explicitly states object bottoms were not scanned; mesh bottoms are untextured.
capture.interior: Not reported per object; bowl/mug internal surface coverage is UNKNOWN.
capture.mesh_native_unit: UNKNOWN; paper table has millimetre physical dimensions, but this does not specify mesh vertex-coordinate units.
capture.watertight_boundary: Watertight is a source statement about Poisson reconstructed mesh, not evidence of physical wall thickness, inner shell, or full scan coverage.

datasets.reported_measurement_source: Paper Table I reports object dimensions in mm and mass in g; paper acknowledgements credit Michael Leddy for measuring physical properties. Measurement tolerance and per-axis nomenclature for vessel entries are not specified in the table.
datasets.paper_citation: Berk Calli et al., The YCB Object and Model Set: Towards Common Benchmarks for Manipulation Research, 2015.

license.attribution: Amazon.com for data; dataset authors/builders as listed by official index; cite Collins et al., CVPR 2022.
license.redistribution: Official download index requires attribution, a CC BY 4.0 license link, and indication of modifications.
license.integration_note: Recheck archive-local terms before commercial use; this catalogue does not provide legal review.

qualification.usefulness: Product metadata, materials, texture/rendering and product-design reference; exclude as a physical scan or calibrated vessel profile source.

objects.title: SHM 17946:0047 — Footed bowl
objects.collection_provenance: Medelhavsmuseet; record source names the Världskulturmuseerna Database; hosted by the Digital Heritage Research Laboratory / Cyprus University of Technology.

reported_facts.name: period
reported_facts.value: C.G. III (850-700 BC), as written in the record

reported_facts.name: shape_description
reported_facts.value: Slightly convex conical foot with conical cavity underneath; stem tapering upward; convex lower body; slightly convex mid-body; ridge between mid-body and upper body; cylindrical upper body; sharp rim; two horizontal round handles on mid-body.

reported_facts.name: interior_decoration
reported_facts.value: Five black concentric circles on bottom are listed in description; this is not evidence of full scan coverage.

derived_ratios.basis: Arithmetic from dimensions explicitly named by the record; not profile measurements.

license.attribution: Attribute Medelhavsmuseet and the Apsida record; ShareAlike terms apply to redistributed adaptations.

visual_inference: Curatorial text supports an approximately axial bowl body with foot/stem and cylindrical upper body; the two handles make it non-axisymmetric overall.
Do not infer measured rim, foot, handle section or wall dimensions from page photographs.
unknowns: OBJ mesh coordinate unit and object-to-mesh calibration
Capture modality and per-object acquisition procedure
Rim cross-section, foot/stem cross-section and handle section
